name: The Ritz-Carlton, Bali

address.street: Jalan Raya Nusa Dua Selatan Lot Iii

insider_take: Perched dramatically on limestone cliffs 300 feet above the Indian Ocean, this clifftop sanctuary offers one of Bali's most spectacular oceanfront settings.
whats_special: The resort features traditional Balinese architecture with hand-carved stone details and sits on sacred ground - the cliff-edge Pura Luhur Uluwatu temple is just minutes away. The three-tier infinity pool creates a stunning visual cascade toward the ocean, while the beach club requires a scenic cliff-side funicular ride down to a pristine white sand cove.
pro_tip: Book the Cliff Villa for unobstructed 180-degree ocean views and your own private butler. The sunset views from your terrace are absolutely unmatched anywhere on the island.
dont_miss: The traditional Kecak fire dance performances at nearby Uluwatu Temple at sunset, and dinner at the resort's cliff-edge restaurant where tables literally hang over the ocean. The hotel's signature treatment at The Ritz-Carlton Spa uses ancient Balinese healing rituals in pavilions overlooking the sea.
pros: Stunning clifftop location with panoramic Indian Ocean views
Exceptional Ritz-Carlton service and hospitality standards
Multiple award-winning dining venues with authentic Balinese cuisine
cons: Located away from central Bali attractions
